name: Wachtberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wachtberg (a white dragon on blue).
history: By deed of 13 April 1971 the municipality of Wachtberg was granted the right to bear arms, and by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Cologne of the same date the right to bear a flag, described as blue, white and blue striped 1:2:1 with the arms imprinted.

features.role: Wachtberg arms — white dragon on blue
